ground_truth.description: When a session call with BEHAVIOR_REVERT_ON_ERROR fails, the transaction reverts but nonce is not consumed. The signature remains valid and can be replayed for partial calls. Session signatures are validated per-call using individual call hashes, enabling partial replay. Frontrunners can execute subsets of calls to grief or cause financial loss.
ground_truth.root_cause: When a session call with BEHAVIOR_REVERT_ON_ERROR fails, the transaction reverts but nonce is not consumed. The signature remains valid and can be replayed for partial calls. Session signatures are validated per-call using individual call hashes, enabling partial replay. Frontrunners can execute subsets of calls to grief or cause financial loss.
ground_truth.attack_scenario: Original payload: Calls [A, B, C] with signatures [SigA, SigB, SigC]. Execution: [A succeed, B succeed, C revert]. Result: Revert, nonce unused. Attack: Replay [A, B] with [SigA, SigB]. PoC: File POC.t.sol with test testSubmissionValidity. It builds a 2-call payload, expects revert on second call, then replays partial payload successfully.
ground_truth.fix_description: Bind session call signatures to the complete payload hash to prevent partial signature replay.

vulnerabilities.explanation: The contract is vulnerable to a signature replay attack when a session call with BEHAVIOR_REVERT_ON_ERROR fails. The transaction reverts, but the nonce is not consumed, allowing the signature to be replayed for partial calls. This is because session signatures are validated per-call using individual call hashes, enabling partial replay.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: 1. An attacker creates a payload with multiple calls (e.g., [A, B, C]) and signs each call individually. 2. The attacker executes the payload, but one of the calls (e.g., B) reverts with BEHAVIOR_REVERT_ON_ERROR. 3. The entire transaction reverts, but the nonce is not consumed. 4. The attacker can then replay the signature for the successful calls (e.g., A and C) or a subset of the calls, potentially causing financial loss or griefing.
vulnerabilities.suggested_fix: Bind session call signatures to the complete payload hash to prevent partial signature replay. This can be achieved by modifying the signature validation to include the entire payload hash rather than individual call hashes.

prediction.overall_explanation: The contract is vulnerable to a signature replay attack due to the way session signatures are validated and nonces are consumed. This vulnerability can be exploited to cause financial loss or griefing. The recommended fix is to bind session call signatures to the complete payload hash.
